scope: Portal SurfaceCatalog scenario-owner embed integration, iframe failure isolation, and hostile bridge admission

commands.assertions: 10 tests pass; opted-in scenario surfaces render through the same-origin embedded proxy, unopted surfaces do not invent URLs, and frame failure leaves the host component usable.
Portal UI compiles with the owner integration.
5 hostile iframe tests pass, including exact parent identity, origin, size, stale-surface, and native-call refusal.

assertions: Scenario surfaces must explicitly advertise vrooli.scenario.embed.v1 before Portal derives a same-origin /embedded/<owner>/ URL.
The frame uses a sandbox and no-referrer policy; a load error renders a local unavailable state.
A scenario surface failure is isolated from Portal workspace state and no credentials or authority are placed in the URL.
Bridge control messages are accepted only from the exact admitted parent and origin.
limitations: The current catalog has no live provider emitting a scenario embed descriptor, so this receipt proves the owner integration path and hostile boundary tests rather than a remote process crash journey.
